summary: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company filed an 8-K reporting the execution of a Third Amendment to its Master Receivables Purchase Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank. The amendment extends the Purchase Termination Date from September 1, 2026 to August 31, 2027, under an uncommitted facility allowing up to $750 million in accounts receivable sales. This is a routine financing arrangement amendment, not a special situation. No extraordinary corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a material definitive agreement disclosure, and no special-situation category applies.
